tools.name: search_calculators
tools.description: Search CalculatorLib by keyword in any of its 12 languages — payroll, tax and social-insurance calculators for Asian markets (year-correct, legal editions cited where available) and about 8,000 general calculators. Returns the best matches (name, title, and a ready-to-use input schema) ranked by relevance and popularity. Call this FIRST, then call run_calculator with the chosen name. Example queries: "Vietnam personal income tax", "lương gross sang net", "mortgage monthly payment", "body mass index".

query.description: Keywords describing the calculation you need.

lang.description: Optional language to search in and to return titles and labels in: en, es, vi, hi, ja, ko, tr, ar, ru, fr, zh, tw, pt, de (zh = Simplified, tw = Traditional Chinese; zh-CN / zh-TW / vi-VN style tags are accepted). Default: auto-detected from the query, so titles may come back in the query's language (e.g. vi, es, fr, ja) rather than English; pass lang (e.g. "en") to fix the language.

tools.name: get_calculator_schema
tools.description: Full input schema (field names, types, units, options) of one calculator. Optional: search_calculators already returns a compact schema per hit.

name.description: Tool name from search_calculators, e.g. bmi_calculator.

lang.description: Optional language for labels, titles and number formatting: en, es, vi, hi, ja, ko, tr, ar, ru, fr, zh, tw, pt, de (zh = Simplified, tw = Traditional Chinese; zh-CN / zh-TW / vi-VN style tags are accepted). Default: en.

tools.name: run_calculator
tools.description: Run a calculator and get the result. Pass the calculator's name (from search_calculators) and its input fields in args under their EXACT field names from that result's inputSchema / fields (call get_calculator_schema first when unsure; display labels are not field names). Returns the computed values plus a share link to the calculator page with inputs pre-filled; calculators backed by a legal edition also return edition, effective_from and sources[] (document, article/clause, URL) to cite. Missing inputs are refused (isError), never defaulted. When the calculator has a formula, the result ALSO includes formula_latex — the formula with the user's values substituted; show it to the user (rendered as LaTeX when your client supports it, otherwise inline as text). Example: {"name":"bmi_calculator","args":{"unitSystem":"metric","weight":70,"height":175}}.

name.description: Tool name from search_calculators, e.g. compound_interest_calculator.

args.description: Input fields keyed by their EXACT field names from the search result's inputSchema/fields or get_calculator_schema, e.g. {"principal": 300000}. Not the display labels.

lang.description: Optional language for labels, titles and number formatting: en, es, vi, hi, ja, ko, tr, ar, ru, fr, zh, tw, pt, de (zh = Simplified, tw = Traditional Chinese; zh-CN / zh-TW / vi-VN style tags are accepted). Default: en.

timezone.description: Optional IANA time zone of the user (e.g. Asia/Seoul, America/New_York) or offset (+09:00): date calculators count "today" in it. Default: the time zone of the lang's country (en = America/New_York).

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a value between units of one category (length, mass, temperature, area, volume, speed, data and 60 more). Names, symbols and common spellings work ("m", "ft", "lbs", "°C"). category is optional when the two units identify it; an unknown unit returns the category's unit list. Example: {"value":10,"from":"Meter","to":"Foot"}.

category.description: Unit category, e.g. length, mass, temperature, area, volume, speed. Optional when from/to belong to only one category; an unknown category returns the list of all 67.

tools.name: solve_math
tools.description: Solve algebra, trigonometry or calculus step by step (equations, systems, derivatives, integrals, limits, simplify/factor). Answers are checked numerically; unverifiable problems are refused. Returns LaTeX + plain answer, steps, checks, page link.

problem.description: LaTeX or text, ≤300 chars, e.g. x^2-5x+6=0
